# Security

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest published version of `tsc-staged`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/microblink/tsc-staged/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected version, steps to reproduce the issue, its potential impact, and any suggested mitigation. Do not open a public issue or pull request for an undisclosed vulnerability.

## Repository checks

GitHub CodeQL scans JavaScript and TypeScript changes on pull requests and pushes to `main`. This automated check supplements security reports. It does not guarantee that the package is free of vulnerabilities.
